messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - smart-routing errors spike (routes failing, >40% 5xx) — paging oncall-sre. Auto-mitigation attempted: region-fallback enabled.

maya: oncall here, seeing a flood of errors from routing layer, looks like requests are being sent to incompatible model variant (quantized v2) for some users.

sam: confirming, traces show model_variant=redwood-v2-q4 for a subset of routes that should map to redwood-v2 or redwood-v2-int8. mismatch in policy table?

lee: Logs aren't showing route tags for those requests, hard to tie to customer routes. Are decision logs disabled?

maya: decision-logging is partial — we only log when debug=true. Default path omitted tags. that's likely why ops couldn't detect it earlier.

tess: customer-impact quick check: three customers showing elevated error-rates (>30% 5xx) — acme-scm, bluebox, and statly. Public-facing endpoints unaffected so far but embeddings calls failing for those tenants.

anya: stack traces from serving show "incompatible-kernel" errors on the quantized runtime after fallback loop triggered. region-fallback bounced traffic between us-west1 and us-east1 for ~7 minutes.

maya: note: fallback policy is misconfigured to prefer region with lower capacity instead of compatible model capability. that's why looped back and kept failing.

sam: mitigation idea 1: immediately disable cross-region auto-fallback for smart-routing. run:
```bash
# temp disable fallback policy
redwoodctl routing patch --policy smart-routing --set allow_cross_region_fallback=false
```

lee: mitigation idea 2: pin affected routes to redwood-v2 (non-quantized) as emergency rollback. will add canary after fix.

maya: I'm going to apply (1) now and pin routes for acme-scm and bluebox. any objections?

oncall-sre: go ahead. I will take over monitoring and pager escalation. tess, can you coordinate customer comms?

maya: applying patch...

deploy-bot: deploy starting: routing-policy-update by maya — diff +1 -1 — env: prod — trace: https://deploys/redwood/9876

maya: patch applied. cross-region fallback disabled.

anya: I'm pushing temporary route overrides for acme-scm and bluebox to redwood-v2 pinned:
```yaml
- route: acme-scm/*
  model: redwood-v2
  override: true
- route: bluebox/*
  model: redwood-v2
  override: true
```

sam: monitoring — error rate dropping for acme-scm within 90s. bluebox also improving. statly still noisy, looks like different subset of routes.

tess: I notified acme-scm and bluebox PMs with status + ETA for full postmortem. statly on the list next.

lee: important post-incident items emerging: (a) decision logs must always include route tags and model_variant choice, (b) fallback policies need a compatibility check step before enabling cross-region, (c) create synthetic checks that validate route->model mappings on deploy.

maya: agree. also add: fail-open vs fail-closed semantics for region fallback; current default is too permissive.

oncall-sre: I'm taking the handoff to night shift. I'll keep fallback disabled and pinned overrides until PMs approve. leaving a runbook note: short-term mitigations in place, do not revert fallback without dogfood tests.

sam: can we add an emergency debug toggle that turns on verbose routing decision logs for affected tenants only? full logging is costly.

anya: yes, we have a scoped-logging flag. I enabled it for statly and backend route groups. will ship logs to debug-s3 for 48h.

maya: quick root-cause hypothesis: policy sync job mass-merged a stale policy file that had model_variant defaults set to q4 quantized for some legacy routes. merge slipped review.

lee: add to RCA: enforce CI that validates merged routing policies against a compatibility matrix (model, kernel support, region).

tess: customer impact summary to include in initial incident update: 3 tenants with degraded embeddings and generation (partial), mitigated by pinning and disabling cross-region fallback; total downtime window ~7–12 minutes per tenant; no data loss.

oncall-sre: logging gaps: decision logs missing route tags (primary observability gap). Created ticket INF-4821 to add mandatory route_tag and model_choice fields to routing decision events.

maya: escalating to platform: we need a follow-up to add a bell for policy merges that change default model_variant for any route.

sam: patch notes for postmortem: short-term mitigations done (fallback disabled, tenant pins, scoped debug logs), next steps (obs improvements, policy CI, safer defaults), owners: lee (obs), anya (policy CI), tess (customer comms), maya (runtime safeguards).

deploy-bot: deploy finished: routing-policy-update by maya — status: success — duration: 00:00:22

tess: thanks everyone. oncall-sre, please keep this thread updated during handoff. I'll draft the public-facing status and share in #general after PM review. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: handoff note: will monitor errors for next 4h, will escalate if error-rate > 5% for any pinned tenant. Leaving detailed notes in the incident tracker: https://incidents/redwood/2024-CRIT-59

maya: adding timeline entries to tracker now. thanks team.

sam: follow-up tasks assigned. closing page.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (P0 -> P1). Updates posted to incident tracker.
